# 1. Load Library & Data

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# Load file dataset mobil bekas Jakarta
df_raw <- read_excel("PSD_DATA_MOBIL_JAKARTA_FULL.xlsx")

# Cek struktur awal data
glimpse(df_raw)
```

# 2. Helper Function RegEx (Ekstraksi Numerik)
Membuat fungsi pembersih teks menggunakan Regular Expression (RegEx) sesuai materi modul Pertemuan 3.

```{r}
# Fungsi 1: Membersihkan Harga_Teks menjadi angka murni
clean_harga_regex <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x)) return(NA_real_)
  x_nodot <- str_remove_all(as.character(x), "[.]")
  digits <- str_extract_all(x_nodot, "[0-9]+")[[1]]
  if (length(digits) > 0) return(as.numeric(paste0(digits, collapse = "")))
  return(NA_real_)
}

# Fungsi 2: Membersihkan range Jarak_Tempuh menjadi nilai tengah numerik
clean_mileage_regex <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x)) return(NA_real_)
  x_nodot <- str_remove_all(as.character(x), "[.]")
  nums <- as.numeric(str_extract_all(x_nodot, "\\d+")[[1]])
  if (length(nums) >= 2) return(mean(nums[1:2]))
  if (length(nums) == 1) return(nums[1])
  return(NA_real_)
}
```

# 3. Proses Manajemen Data & Feature Engineering
Menjalankan deduplikasi, ekstraksi peubah baru dari teks Judul, transformasi usia mobil, klasifikasi merek, serta binning jarak tempuh.


```{r}
df_managed <- df_raw %>%
  # Deduplikasi iklan berdasarkan URL Detail
  distinct(URL_Detail, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  
  # RegEx Processing & Feature Extraction
  mutate(
    # Cleaning peubah teks ke numerik
    Harga_Clean     = sapply(Harga_Teks, clean_harga_regex),
    Odometer_KM     = sapply(Jarak_Tempuh, clean_mileage_regex),
    
    # Ekstraksi liter mesin dari Judul (contoh: 2.4, 1.5)
    Liter_Mesin     = as.numeric(str_extract(Judul, "\\b(\\d\\.\\d)\\b")),
    
    # Konversi Kapasitas_Mesin (Text Range) ke Midpoint CC
    CC_Mesin        = case_when(
      str_detect(Kapasitas_Mesin, "<1.000") ~ 850,
      str_detect(Kapasitas_Mesin, "1.000 - 1.500") ~ 1250,
      str_detect(Kapasitas_Mesin, "1.500 - 2.000") ~ 1750,
      str_detect(Kapasitas_Mesin, "2.000 - 3.000") ~ 2500,
      str_detect(Kapasitas_Mesin, ">3.000") ~ 3500,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    # CC Final (Hybrid: Gunakan Liter_Mesin * 1000 jika presisi, sisanya fallback ke CC_Mesin)
    CC_Final        = ifelse(!is.na(Liter_Mesin), Liter_Mesin * 1000, CC_Mesin),
    
    # Feature Matching Boolean dari Judul via RegEx str_detect
    Is_Garansi      = str_detect(Judul, "(?i)GARANSI"),
    Is_KM_Low       = str_detect(Judul, "(?i)KM\\s*LOW|LOW\\s*KM|ANTIK"),
    Is_Facelift     = str_detect(Judul, "(?i)FACELIFT|FL|LCI"),
    Is_Sport_Trim   = str_detect(Judul, "(?i)AMG|TRD|RS|SPORT|M-SPORT"),
    Is_Promo_DP     = str_detect(Judul, "(?i)TDP|DP\\s*\\d+|DP\\s*MURAH"),
    
    # Transformasi Usia Mobil
    Tahun_Num       = as.numeric(Tahun),
    Usia_Mobil      = 2026 - Tahun_Num,
    
    # Klasifikasi Segmentasi Merek (Brand Tier)
    Brand_Tier      = case_when(
      toupper(Merk) %in% c("MERCEDES-BENZ", "BMW", "LEXUS", "AUDI", "PORSCHE", "MINI", "LAND ROVER") ~ "Luxury",
      toupper(Merk) %in% c("TOYOTA", "HONDA", "MITSUBISHI", "SUZUKI", "DAIHATSU", "NISSAN", "MAZDA", "HYUNDAI") ~ "Mass Market",
      toupper(Merk) %in% c("WULING", "CHERY", "BYD", "MG") ~ "Chinese EV",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    
    # Binning Odometer (Pengelompokan Diskrit)
    Odometer_Group  = cut(
      Odometer_KM,
      breaks = c(-1, 20000, 50000, 100000, 1000000),
      labels = c("<20k (Sangat Low)", "20k-50k (Low)", "50k-100k (Sedang)", ">100k (Tinggi)")
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Outlier Filtering (Membuang harga DP murahan & outlier ekstrim)
  filter(
    Harga_Clean >= 30000000 & Harga_Clean <= 5000000000,
    !is.na(Odometer_KM)
  )
```

```{r}
df_managed
```


# 4. Evaluasi Hasil Manajemen Data
```{r}
# Ringkasan Peubah Hasil Filtering
summary(df_managed %>% select(Harga_Clean, Odometer_KM, Usia_Mobil))

# Distribusi Brand Tier
table(df_managed$Brand_Tier)

# Frekuensi Tag Hasil RegEx
df_managed %>% 
  summarise(
    Total_Garansi = sum(Is_Garansi, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_KM_Low  = sum(Is_KM_Low, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Sport   = sum(Is_Sport_Trim, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Promo_DP= sum(Is_Promo_DP, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
